ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Venus

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.
